_comment: Sample npm artifact manifest for Qbix itself. The package that powers the Safebox plugin's Node side. Internal packages installed this way get the same M-of-N treatment as third-party ones — no special path for first-party code.
name: qbix

metadata.note: First-party doesn't mean unverified-by-default. The Qbix maintainer signs releases with a key whose public part is part of the M-of-N quorum for `packages/node/install` actions. This puts the Qbix release process under the same governance as everything else.
